source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex-limited and sex-influenced traits, block for block, with the Kitab ki ghalti box (PDF 110-111).

blocks.text: Kuch khasiyatein sex-linked nahi hotin (kyunke un ke alleles sex chromosomes par nahi), phir bhi un ki ratio nar aur maada mein mukhtalif hoti hai. Aisi khasiyaton ki do qismein hain.

In khasiyaton ke genes dono jinson mein hote hain lekin jismani banawat (anatomy) ya hormones ke farq ki wajah se sirf aik jins mein zahir hote hain. Inhein sex-limited traits kehte hain. Misaal: nar aur maada bhed (sheep) dono mein seengon ki nashonuma ke genes hote hain, lekin yeh sirf nar bhed mein zahir hote hain. Isi tarah doodh banane ke genes nar aur maada dono mammals mein hote hain, lekin sirf maada mein zahir hote hain. Insanon mein daarhi ugne ke genes sirf mardon mein zahir hote hain. Isi tarah prostate cancer ke genes sirf mardon mein aur ovarian cancer ke genes sirf auraton mein zahir hote hain, halanke yeh dono genes mardon aur auraton dono mein maujood hote hain.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Sex-limited genes sexual dimorphism ke zimmedar hain, yaani aik hi species ke nar aur maada ke phenotype (shakal o surat) mein farq, genotype chahe kuch bhi ho.

Kuch khasiyaton mein aik hi gene har jins mein alag tareeqe se zahir hota hai. Sex-influenced genes ke alleles aik jins mein dominant aur doosri mein recessive hote hain; yeh farq nar aur maada ke hormones ke farq se hai. Misaal: insanon mein jism ke baalon ki miqdar aur ganj-pan (baldness) sex-influenced khasiyatein hain. Ganj-pan ka allele mardon mein dominant aur auraton mein recessive hai. Is liye mard tab ganja ho sakta hai jab woh baldness allele ke liye homozygous (BB) ya heterozygous (Bb) ho, jab ke aurat sirf tab ganji ho sakti hai jab us ke paas baldness ke do alleles (BB) hon.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne aakhir mein likha hai ke aurat sirf 'do recessive alleles (bb)' se ganji hoti hai. Kitab ne B ko baldness ka allele likha hai, aur auraton mein yahi allele recessive hai; is liye ganji aurat ke paas baldness ke do alleles, yaani BB, hone chahiyen. bb ka matlab hai baldness ka koi allele nahi.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text:
Genetics ne bohat taraqqi ki hai aur ab yeh amli (applied) science hai. Misalein:
• DNA sequencing aur genetic engineering se researchers genes ko badal (manipulate) sakte hain.
• Human Genome Project mukammal hone se bimariyon aur khasiyaton ki genetic bunyad behtar samajh aayi hai.
• Genetics sehat (healthcare) mein ahem hai: doctors mareez ki apni genetic profile ke mutabiq tashkhees (diagnosis) aur ilaaj karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Sex-limited aur sex-influenced khasiyat mein kya farq hai? Har aik ki aik misaal dein.
blocks.explanation: Sex-limited khasiyat sirf aik jins mein zahir hoti hai, halanke genes dono mein hain (nar bhed mein seeng, maada mammals mein doodh). Sex-influenced khasiyat dono jinson mein ho sakti hai, lekin us ka allele aik jins mein dominant aur doosri mein recessive hai (ganj-pan: mard BB ya Bb ganja, aurat sirf BB ganji).

items: Dono qismein sex-linked nahi: in ke genes autosomes par hain.
Sex-limited: genes dono mein, zahir sirf aik jins mein (seeng, doodh, daarhi).
Sex-influenced: allele aik jins mein dominant, doosri mein recessive (ganj-pan: mard BB/Bb, aurat BB).
